§9.3 STS Technical Data, Inverter side block (PDF pages 339–340): the GW60K-STS-G10 column prints Rated Power (kW) 30, Max. Current 100.0, Rated. Current 43.5@400V. A per-model column, independent of the datasheet's merged cell — two hosted documents for the same value.
§9.3 Technische Daten des STS, Wechselrichterseite: the GW60K-STS-G10 column prints Nennleistung (kW) 30, Max. Strom 100.0, Nennstrom 43.5@400V. Same value as the EN V1.5.
